استبرئت (form X)

# اُسْتُبْرِئْتَ (ustubriʔta) /us.tub.riʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# اُسْتُبْرِئْتِ (ustubriʔti) /us.tub.riʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# اُسْتُبْرِئَتْ (ustubriʔat) /u
